notesEn: 0.3.67: seq reconciliation guard for session logs — cross-machine writes to the same session are merged by seq instead of whole-file overwrite, eliminating DSH 'seq gap / session log corrupt' on startup; .gitattributes now marks conversations/sessions/**/*.zstd as binary and workspace/** as -text; capture.ps1 hoists the tree-compare helpers above their first use (they were defined after the call site, so -WorkspaceOnly failed with Test-TreeFileChanged not recognized).
notes: 0.3.67: 会话日志 seq 对账护栏——跨机各写同一会话时不再整文件覆盖，改为按 seq 求并集，彻底消除 DSH 启动报 'seq gap / session log corrupt'；.gitattributes 补 conversations/sessions/**/*.zstd binary 与 workspace/** -text；capture.ps1 把大目录比较函数上移到脚本前部（原先定义晚于调用，-WorkspaceOnly 直接报 Test-TreeFileChanged 未定义）。
